Auto Repair & Collision FAQs

Answers about estimates, insurance claims, and visiting our Long Island City, Queens repair shop. Call us to discuss your specific vehicle or claim.

Call (718) 578-4563

How long does collision repair take in NYC?

Timing depends on the damage, repair scope, parts availability, and any insurance approvals. Contact our Long Island City shop to discuss the expected timeline for your vehicle rather than relying on a general estimate.

Will my insurance company pay for repair at your shop?

Payment depends on your policy, deductible, covered damage, and insurer approval. We work with adjusters and handle repair paperwork, but cannot promise that an insurer will pay for every repair item.

Do you work with my insurance company?

We coordinate repair work with insurance adjusters and help with claim paperwork. Tell us your insurance company and share any available claim information so we can discuss your specific claim with you.

What is a supplement, and do I need one?

A supplement documents additional or changed repair work for your insurer to review, such as damage identified during evaluation. Whether one is needed depends on your repair scope; it does not guarantee additional coverage or payment.

Do you offer a warranty on repairs and paint?

Call us to confirm the warranty terms for your specific repair or paint work before authorizing it. Ask for any coverage, time or mileage limits, and exclusions in writing.

Do you offer a rental car during repairs?

Call us before your repair to ask about rental or alternative transportation arrangements. If you are using insurance, ask your insurer whether your policy includes rental reimbursement and what limits apply.

Where is MasterCraft, and what are your hours?

We are at 38-21 23rd Street, Long Island City, NY 11101, in Queens. The shop is open every day from 6 AM to 12 AM, midnight.

How do I request an estimate and send damage photos?

Use the estimate form to send your contact information, vehicle details, and a description of the problem, or call (718) 578-4563. You can attach up to 10 JPG, PNG, or WebP photos, no larger than 10 MB each; an in-person inspection may be needed to establish the full repair scope.
